title: Ned Is Unsure
note: b385. P2's 'faint dotted outline where the stone was' and p7's 'half unseen in the mud' both reuse the existing 'pebble'/'mud' props with opacity/layering rather than a new dashed-outline mechanism (the kit draws solid shapes only, never a dash pattern on anything but the existing motion_arc). Ned's own shadow (p2) and the page's colour returning (p5) are not literally drawable and are left to the composition instead.

pages.brief: Ned the gold duckling at the pond edge staring at a small empty dip in the mud where a stone clearly used to sit. Shoulders down, beak down. Overcast grey-green — the flattest page in the book.
pages.alt: Ned stares at a small empty dip in the mud at the pond edge where a stone clearly used to sit, shoulders and beak down on a flat overcast page.

pages.brief: The same empty dip in the mud, drawn closer and larger, with a faint dotted outline where the stone was. Ned's shadow falls across it. Quiet and a bit eerie.
pages.alt: The same empty mud dip, drawn closer and larger, with only a faint ghosted outline of where the stone used to be — quiet and a little eerie.

pages.brief: Olive the plum owl on a branch with one wing up in warning; below her Ned already chest-deep in the pond, rings spreading out. Split the page between her calm and his splashing.
pages.alt: Olive the owl sits calmly on a branch with one wing raised in warning, while below her Ned is already chest-deep in the pond, rings spreading out around him.

pages.brief: Ned standing on the bank dripping, down plastered flat so he looks half his normal size, water running off his tail. Nell the bee hovering nearby, trying hard not to laugh.
pages.alt: Ned stands dripping on the bank, his down plastered flat so he looks half his normal size, while Nell the bee hovers nearby trying hard not to laugh.

pages.brief: Nell the sunflower-yellow bee hovering with one leg pointing firmly down, absolutely certain. Ned looking up at her with dawning hope. Colour floods back into the page here.
pages.alt: Nell hovers with one leg pointing firmly down, absolutely certain, while Ned looks up at her with dawning hope.

pages.brief: Nell pulling reed stems apart like curtains; Olive stepping into the shallows with an expression of deep distaste, one foot lifted high. Detailed reeds, brown water, comic dignity.
pages.alt: Nell pulls the reed stems apart like curtains while Olive steps into the shallows with one foot lifted high, an expression of deep distaste on her face.

pages.brief: The stone half buried in dark mud, one polished grey curve catching the light. Ned's face right up close to it, eyes enormous. Warm light breaking through the reeds.
pages.alt: The stone sits half buried in dark mud, one polished grey curve catching the light, as Ned's face comes right up close to it, eyes enormous.

pages.brief: Ned sitting squarely and smugly on top of the stone at the water's edge, wings folded, immovable. Late gold light on the pond. Nell and Olive behind him, amused.
pages.alt: Ned sits squarely and smugly on top of the stone at the water's edge, wings folded and immovable, with Nell and Olive behind him looking amused in the late gold light.
